question: According to which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India can the Parliament amend the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 368**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amendment of Indian Constitution:**

 
 
• **Under Article 368, the parliament can amend the Constitution. Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
 
• **Amending the constitution of India** is the process of making amendments to the fundamental law or supreme law of the country.
 
• The amendment process in the constitution is set out in** Part XX (Article 368) of the Indian Constitution.**
 
• This procedure preserves the sanctity of India's Constitution and holds a check on the Indian Parliament's arbitrary power.
 
• Article **368 does not **set down the legislative process to be followed at various points of the amendment.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Article 103**
 Decision on questions as to disqualifications of members.
 
 

 **Article 129**
 Supreme Court to be a court of record.
 
 

 **Article 234**
 Recruitment of persons other than district judges to the judicial service.
